accountEvidence.content: RFC 4648 padded base64 of the complete strict canonical account-auth-evidence-bundle/v1 bytes
accountEvidence.validation: Decode with the existing closed variant codec, including canonical re-encoding equality, before framing. This member binds every byte including bundleVersion, snapshotIdentity, evaluationIdentity, entitlement fields, complete authorityTuple, tenantBillingCutoff and outboxCheckpoints. No digest/subset/loose JSON substitute is accepted.

sourceLimits: The existing PLAYER_ADMISSION and TENANT_OPERATION strict decoders apply their bounded raw UTF-8, duplicate-key, nesting, token, member, array and canonical-reencoding checks before this family is framed.
status: Published source contract and proof definitions only. World lifecycle and authoritative zero-delta prior-shape producers are held; this schema does not activate them.
